title: Joining Armstrong in Detroit in 1931 and who assembled the band
summary: Randolph joined at the Greystone Ballroom in June 1931 and, asked whether he selected the men, names George James, Al Washington, Tubby Hall, Johnny Lindsay and Preston Jackson.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Is this when Louie came back in the band -- opened at the Regal?
Well, no -- well, yeah, this was when he came back, but this was after I had joined Louie. See, I joined Louie in June in Indianapolis. That's where the Greystone Ballroom is, isn't it?
Detroit? Well, I joined him in Detroit then. That's where it was -- yeah, the Greystone Ballroom in Detroit.
Many of the history books say that you put the band together.

I arranged -- well, you see, I don't know how to get that straight, but, now -- how many bands did I get together for him? Now, this band was -- the band broke up, I did get the band together for him. Yeah, I did put -- one, two, three -- let's see, George James and Al Washington.
Tubby Hall, rather. And John Lindsay.
Johnny Lindsay and -- Tubby Hall, Johnny Lindsay and Preston Jackson -- [PAUSE]
Did you select the men? Did Louie or did --
